text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working developer with 6 years of experience building machine learning and NLP solutions, and I’d love to help create your custom document management and chatbot system.

I have strong experience with Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, pandas, XGBoost, and machine learning, which fits well with building a RAG-based workflow for document retrieval and intelligent chat support. I can help design a practical, cost-effective system that organizes school and personal documents, supports easy uploads and categorization, and uses open-source-friendly approaches for long-term maintenance and scalability.

I’m especially interested in building systems that improve over time while staying efficient and maintainable.

Would you like the chatbot to focus first on answering questions from existing documents, or should it also include document upload and categorization from the start?
